results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Split Squat
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Stand facing away from the handles, placing one foot in a handle, and step forward with the other foot to assume a split stance.
Lower your body by bending your front knee until your thigh is parallel to the floor, keeping your back leg slightly bent and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position, keeping your back leg bent throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower into the squat.
Ensure your front knee tracks over your toes to maintain proper alignment.
Keep your chest up and shoulders back to maintain proper posture.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Split Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Straight Hip Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Lie on your back with your heels in the handles, legs extended, and arms by your sides for support.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your heels.
Bend your knees to pull with your heels towards your glutes and stop just before they touch together.
Slowly extend your legs back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Perform the movement with a steady and controlled tempo to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily: exhale as you curl your legs and inhale as you extend them back.
Focus on using your hamstrings and glutes to perform the leg curl, avoiding excessive use of your lower back.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Straight Hip Leg Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Wall Sit Bodyweight
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet shoulder-width apart, about 2 feet away from the wall.
Slide your back down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor, and your knees are directly above your ankles.
Hold this position, keeping your back flat against the wall and your hands relaxed by your sides or on your thighs.
Maintain the position for the desired duration, then slowly stand back up.
tips: Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes to avoid placing unnecessary strain on your joints.
Breathe steadily and avoid holding your breath during the exercise.
Press your lower back firmly against the wall to ensure proper alignment.
results.description: Wall Sit Bodyweight is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Core.

results.name: Wall Squat Bodyweight
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet shoulder-width apart, about 2 feet away from the wall.
Slide your back down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor and your knees are at a 90-degree angle, ensuring your knees are directly above your ankles.
Push through your heels to stand back up, sliding your back up the wall until you return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes to avoid placing unnecessary strain on your joints.
Breathe steadily: inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you stand back up.
Press your lower back firmly against the wall to ensure proper alignment and support.
results.description: Wall Squat Bodyweight is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Core.

results.name: Wall Squat With Pause Bodyweight
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet shoulder-width apart, about 2 feet away from the wall.
Slide your back down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor and your knees are at a 90-degree angle, ensuring your knees are directly above your ankles.
Pause for 5-10 seconds and then push through your heels to stand back up, sliding your back up the wall until you return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes to avoid placing unnecessary strain on your joints.
Breathe steadily: inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you stand back up.
Press your lower back firmly against the wall to ensure proper alignment and support.
results.description: Wall Squat With Pause Bodyweight is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Core.

results.name: Barbell Clean Grip Front Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with a clean grip (palms facing up, elbows pointing forward). The barbell should rest on the front of your shoulders, and your fingers should be under the bar to support it.
Begin the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, lowering your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor or slightly below.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, extending your hips and knees fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your elbows stay high throughout the movement to keep the barbell in place.
Lower your body slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower down.
results.description: Barbell Clean Grip Front Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Clean Pull
instructions: Start in a squatted position with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly pointed out, holding a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. The barbell should be on the floor in front of you.
Begin the lift by pushing through your heels, extending your hips and knees to lift the barbell off the floor.
As the barbell passes your knees, explosively extend your hips and knees while shrugging your shoulders and pulling the barbell to your midsection and up to chest level.
Lower the barbell back to the floor with control, maintaining a straight back and engaged core. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on leg drive to generate power from your lower body during the lift.
Maintain a neutral spine to avoid rounding your back and prevent injury.
Use your legs and hips to drive the barbell up, minimizing the strain on your lower back.
results.description: Barbell Clean Pull is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Shoulders.

results.name: Barbell Clean and Jerk Split Squat
instructions: Lean with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip. Clean the barbell to your shoulders by explosively lifting it from the floor, shrugging your shoulders, and rotating your wrists so the bar rests on your shoulders with your elbows pointing forward.
Engage your core and slightly dip your knees. Explosively push the barbell overhead by extending your legs and arms fully.

Step into a split squat position by moving one leg forward and the other leg back, lowering your body until your back knee nearly touches the floor. Ensure your front knee tracks over your toes and your back knee is bent.

Push through the heel of your front foot to stand back up, bringing your feet together while keeping the barbell overhead. Carefully lower the barbell back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, alternating the leg that steps forward for each rep.
tips: Move explosively but with control to ensure proper form and maximize muscle engagement.
Ensure your knees track over your toes to prevent knee injuries and maintain proper alignment.
Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement to maintain proper posture.
results.description: Barbell Clean and Jerk Split Squat is an advanced multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back, Triceps.

results.name: Barbell Clean and Press
instructions: Start in a squatted position with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip. The barbell should be on the floor in front of you.

Explosively lift the barbell by extending your hips and knees, shrugging your shoulders, and rotating your wrists so the bar rests on your shoulders with your elbows pointing forward (clean position).
From the clean position, engage your core and press the barbell overhead by extending your arms fully. Keep the bar slightly behind your head at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the barbell back to your shoulders with control, then return the barbell to the floor by reversing the clean movement. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on leg drive during the clean to generate power from your lower body.
Keep your grip firm but not too tight to allow smooth wrist rotation during the clean.
Exhale powerfully as you press the bar overhead to stabilize your core.
results.description: Barbell Clean and Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back, Triceps.

results.name: Barbell Full Clean
instructions: Bend at your hips and knees to grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Begin the lift by pushing through your heels, extending your hips and knees to lift the barbell off the floor.

As the barbell passes your knees, explosively extend your hips and knees, lightly jumping, while shrugging your shoulders and pulling the barbell up to your chest level. Rotate your elbows under the bar to catch it in a front squat position.

Lower your body into a full squat with the barbell resting on your front shoulders, elbows high, and chest up. Push through your heels to stand back up, fully extending your hips and knees. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows high during the catch to maintain the barbell's position on your shoulders.
Engage your core to support your lower back and maintain stability throughout the movement.
Use your legs and hips to generate power and drive the barbell up.
results.description: Barbell Full Clean is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Shoulders, Calves.
